samples.finding: Oklahoma alternative publisher. Explicit 20261103 date, status pre and is_official=false. Candidate roster/county associations present, but vote arrays and county values are null; not imported or treated as zero. Potential independent delivery path to revisit when actual counts appear.
Alabama alternative publisher returns status pre and an empty contests list. No usable raw race counts.
Official Alabama election-night endpoint returned an ASP.NET form without current raw results in the inspected document. AL-02 uses the validated full-race CivicAPI response.

National CSV: 435 House and 35 Senate candidate totals, plus other offices ignored. All inspected votes zero. Explicit CivicAPI attribution; no explicit election-date/test-data columns. Strict catalog validation, aggregate-only lower-priority fallback. Full-race CivicAPI endpoint validation and official feeds remain preferred.

Official Louisiana Senate raw counts by all64 parishes. Adapter binds dated file to the official election catalog and rejects malformed values. Final collector source la_senate archives both payload and election metadata.

retrieval_findings: Tennessee official state results page and elections.tn.gov/results.php returned HTTP403 to this client; competitive TN races use full-race CivicAPI counts.
Oklahoma official current-election app returned HTTP403. The secondary Facts First scaffold contains null vote fields, so it was not promoted to a zero-vote source.

An initial parallel CivicAPI probe had many transient HTTP502 responses. A slower retry recovered52 of53 selected failed requests; a bounded final Minnesota Senate retry succeeded. The final actual Collector pass validated all60 configured CivicAPI race endpoints. Gateway failure is distinct from missing votes.
Alaska official PDF previously parsed successfully but later failed TLS certificate verification. Collection fails closed without disabling certificate checks.
Maryland results subdomain began redirecting to elections.maryland.gov; registry uses the verified canonical HTTPS URL. The final page still reports NR for all8 House contests.
scope: Public raw counts only. No forecast, call, expected-vote or prediction endpoint contributes to the model.
